settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Register a vector or LLM credential. The secret is stored at rest; the list only shows a key hint. Pipeline plugins reference it with binding_id — never put api_key in params. There is no separate rerank credential kind; wire real rerank models via a custom plugin.
settings.credentialSaved: Saved (plaintext is never returned in the list)

plugins.title: Plugin hub
plugins.subtitle: Builtin catalog comes from the server registry. bge-reranker is an LLM stand-in; real Cross-Encoders (e.g. BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3) need a custom plugin. Custom .py upload is M5; browse-only for now.

pipelines.title: Pipelines
pipelines.subtitle: Browse saved pipelines; Add or Edit picks plugins per stage. Query retriever slot can use Hybrid: dense + bm25, then rrf fusion. Builtin reranker is an LLM stand-in; real rerank models need a custom plugin.

slot.hybridHint: Hybrid recall: run dense + bm25, then merge with fusion/rrf.
slot.rerankHint: Builtin bge-reranker is an LLM stand-in (pick an LLM credential). Real Cross-Encoders such as BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 need a custom plugin that calls /rerank. Credentials stay vector | LLM only.
slot.ensembleNeedTwo: Hybrid mode needs at least two retriever plugins

schema.noParams: This plugin needs no params (use model bindings for secrets).
schema.stringTagsHint:
Use 
 / 

 for newlines; clear to fall back to plugin defaults. Trailing (empty) means character-level split.

kb.title: Knowledge bases
kb.subtitle: Browse knowledge bases; Add creates one, then the detail page uploads documents and runs ingest. Vector credential is inherited from the ingest pipeline embedder slot; chat LLM comes from the query pipeline. Default loader=auto routes by type; pipelines can also pin text/markup/layout/table/ocr. Changing chunking or embeddings needs a new collection and re-ingest.
kb.deleteConfirm: Delete this knowledge base? Documents and vectors will be removed; chat history is kept.
kb.deleteDocumentConfirm: Delete this document? File, chunks, and embeddings will be removed.
kb.uploadHint: txt/md, json, csv, html, pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx, and common images. Upload runs parse + ingest automatically. Images/scanned PDFs use ocr (system Tesseract required).

chat.deleteSessionConfirm: This cannot be undone. Delete this conversation?
chat.askHint: Pick a past conversation on the left, or ask directly (defaults to the first knowledge base and query pipeline).
chat.inputPlaceholder: Type a question. Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.stageSummaryOnly: Summary only (older runs lack full stage output)

comingSoon.scenariosDesc: Eval items, evidence spans, and metric weights arrive in the compare/eval milestone.
comingSoon.experimentsDesc: Compare multiple query pipelines, run eval, view results, and promote.

scenarios.title: Scenarios
scenarios.subtitle: A scenario is a knowledge base plus gold questions, document evidence spans, and metric weights used by experiments.
scenarios.empty: No scenarios yet. Create one, then add gold questions and evidence quotes.
scenarios.deleteConfirm: Delete this scenario and its gold set?
scenarios.metricsRequired: Select at least one evaluator plugin
scenarios.question: Question
scenarios.deleteItemConfirm: Delete this gold question and its spans?
scenarios.spansHint: Paste evidence quotes from documents in this knowledge base (not chunk IDs).
scenarios.spanRequired: Pick a document and paste a quote
scenarios.importHint: Import a UTF-8 CSV or JSON gold set. document can be a document id, title, or filename. Same question on multiple CSV rows adds more spans.

experiments.title: Experiments
experiments.subtitle: Pick a scenario and two or more query pipelines, run offline eval, and rank pipelines by weighted metrics.
experiments.empty: No experiments yet. Create one with at least two query pipelines to compare.
experiments.deleteConfirm: Delete this experiment and its compare plan?
experiments.pipelinesHint: Select at least two existing query pipelines. Each becomes one arm of the compare run.
experiments.pipelinesMin: Select at least two query pipelines
experiments.variantsHint: Each selected query pipeline is one compare arm.
experiments.runHint: Each query pipeline is queued as its own job and runs in parallel; this page polls per-pipeline progress.
experiments.promoteConfirm: Set the winning query pipeline as this knowledge base default?
experiments.promoteHint: Promote sets the KB default query pipeline to the winner (reuses that pipeline when it was compared as-is).
experiments.noRuns: No runs yet. Click Run evaluation.
